cases.sentence: Верно, как и то, что жив Бог, отказавший мне в ___.
cases.explain: The phrase 'отказавший в справедливости' uses genitive after the preposition 'в'; 'в справедливости' means 'in justice/right'.

cases.sentence: Пока дышит во мне моя жизнь и ___ Божья в моих ноздрях.
cases.explain: The noun дыхание (breath) is one element of a compound subject joined by 'и' (and); nominative marks the subject.

cases.sentence: Не скажут неправды мои ___, и язык мой обмана не произнесет.
cases.explain: The noun уста (lips) is the subject of the verb 'скажут' (will speak); nominative case marks the subject.
The preposition 'о' (about) governs the prepositional case; 'о силе' means 'about strength/power'.

cases.sentence: Держусь за свою ___ и не отступлю от нее.
cases.explain: The preposition 'за' (after, behind, for) governs the accusative case; 'держусь за правоту' means 'hold fast to righteousness'.

cases.sentence: Ведь что за надежда у ___, когда приходит ему конец?
cases.explain: The preposition 'у' (with, at) governs the genitive case; 'у безбожника' means 'of/with the godless one'.
The verb 'лишает' (deprives/takes away) requires the genitive case; 'лишает жизни' means 'deprives of life'.

cases.sentence: Палящий ___ его подхватит и с места его снесет.
cases.explain: The noun ветер (wind) is the subject of the verb 'подхватит' (will carry); nominative marks the subject.

reading.ru: Верно, как и то, что жив Бог, отказавший мне в справедливости, всемогущий, наполнивший мою душу горечью, пока дышит во мне моя жизнь и дыхание Божье в моих ноздрях, не скажут неправды мои уста, и язык мой обмана не произнесет.
reading.question: What does Job swear regarding his lips and tongue?
options: His lips will not speak unrighteousness and his tongue will not utter deceit
He will speak only truth as long as God gives him breath
He will justify his friends' words and confess his sins
He will curse God and demand his justice
reading.correct: His lips will not speak unrighteousness and his tongue will not utter deceit
reading.explain: The text explicitly states: 'не скажут неправды мои уста, и язык мой обмана не произнесет' — my lips will not speak unrighteousness and my tongue will not utter deceit.

reading.ru: Никогда не признаю вас правыми, пока не умру, не оставлю своей непорочности, я держусь за свою правоту и не отступлю от нее.
reading.question: What is Job's commitment regarding his integrity and righteousness?
options: He will never abandon his integrity or righteousness until he dies
He will eventually admit his friends were right
He will compromise his principles to achieve peace
He will blame God for his suffering
reading.correct: He will never abandon his integrity or righteousness until he dies
reading.explain: The text states: 'не оставлю своей непорочности, я держусь за свою правоту и не отступлю от нее' — I will not abandon my integrity and hold fast to my righteousness.

reading.ru: Ведь что за надежда у безбожника, когда приходит ему конец, когда Бог лишает его жизни?
reading.question: What does Job ask about the hope of the godless?
options: What hope does the godless have when his end comes and God takes his life?
Can the godless escape God's judgment through repentance?
Will God show mercy to those who have rejected him?
Does the godless person achieve peace before death?
reading.correct: What hope does the godless have when his end comes and God takes his life?
reading.explain: The text directly poses this rhetorical question: 'Ведь что за надежда у безбожника, когда приходит ему конец, когда Бог лишает его жизни?'

reading.ru: Я вас наставлю о Божьей силе, и путей всемогущего не утаю.
reading.question: What does Job offer to do regarding God's attributes?
options: He will teach them about God's power and not conceal the Almighty's ways
He will prove his innocence through God's revealed truth
He will show them the error of their reasoning
He will teach them to fear God and obey his commands
reading.correct: He will teach them about God's power and not conceal the Almighty's ways
reading.explain: The text states: 'Я вас наставлю о Божьей силе, и путей всемогущего не утаю' — I will teach you about God's power and will not conceal the Almighty's ways.

reading.ru: Вот удел злодеям от Бога, вот наследие, что примет гонитель от всемогущего.
reading.question: What does Job describe as the portion of the wicked from God?
options: The wicked receive judgment and oppressors receive punishment from the Almighty
The wicked receive temporary prosperity and power
The wicked are forgiven and receive God's mercy
reading.correct: The wicked receive judgment and oppressors receive punishment from the Almighty
reading.explain: The passage introduces a description of the fate of the wicked: 'вот удел злодеям от Бога, вот наследие, что примет гонитель от всемогущего' — This is the portion of the wicked from God.

reading.ru: Палящий ветер его подхватит и с места его снесет. Безжалость ринется на него, когда он побежит от него стремглав.
reading.question: How does Job describe the fate of the wicked man?
options: The east wind carries him away and he is pursued mercilessly as he flees
He escapes God's judgment through wealth and power
He finds refuge and is protected from harm
reading.correct: The east wind carries him away and he is pursued mercilessly as he flees
reading.explain: The text vividly describes: 'Палящий ветер его подхватит и с места его снесет. Безжалость ринется на него' — The east wind carries him away, mercilessness pursues him.
